notes: A field whose type is a class name (RWorldCell, StreamSlot, SbButton) is an embedded array of that struct (size = stride, count = length). Many labels of this group were mixes of unrelated objects (Menu, Formation, Popup, Slot, Squad, Cache, Text, Workshop); their functions were moved to the owning objects (see each class note) and alias labels (BitWriter/BitQueue/ComPtr -> Image, Progress/Seq -> SaveLoad, InfoPanel/Images -> SaveMenu, HlBar -> ScrollBox, ModeList/HudSlots -> ScrollBar, Layer2D -> Sprite2D, SoundEntry -> StreamSlot, Window -> Dev, Text -> Font2d, EditBox -> TextBox, TxtRes -> TextRes) kept as empty classes with base = the real object. All t_interf.cpp / t_basic.cpp text lookups (~370, no field accesses) were moved to TxtRes. Duplicates to merge: Image = Surface (g03), MainMenu = Interface (g06), Sms = QuickBar (g06) / PickupNotice (g14), OptMenu = Panel (g15, which derives from it), Panels = Sounds (g10). Moved to other groups: Place (g04: place_units, slot_of, tick_4c3330, get_52, get_56 -> needs +0x5a, +0xc2, +0xc6 positions, +0x192 slot ids), UnitCmd (g04: squadcmd.cpp helpers -> needs +0x24), Collisions (g04), Display (g04), Order (g10), ObjectiveMenu (g07), Boid (g03), Unit (g09), Nation (g12), Siege (g05), Game (g11), Help (g11), ChatBox (g04), ComboBox (g14), CutScene (g14), Glory (g06), SlideMenu (g06), IngameMenu (g06), PopupWin (g01), TextBox (g01), Sound3DSystem (g14).
